```{r}
report_target_store <- Sys.getenv("TRANSPLANT_TARGET_STORE", "_targets")
if (!grepl("^/", report_target_store)) {
  report_target_store <- file.path(here::here(), report_target_store)
}
report_target_store <- normalizePath(report_target_store, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
report_target_config <- tempfile(fileext = ".yaml")
targets::tar_config_set(store = report_target_store, config = report_target_config)
Sys.setenv(TAR_CONFIG = report_target_config)
```

## AUC construction and validation


### Purpose

Report plot-level AUC construction, contrast output, and covariance/classification checks.

### Inputs

Canonical community cover, experiment durations, and the reviewed analysis configuration.

### Decisions and exclusions

The response is raw relative-cover maximum-duration AUC; resident-model species exclusions are not applied here.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
auc <- targets::tar_read(auc_inputs)$auc
contrasts <- targets::tar_read(auc_contrasts)
validation <- targets::tar_read(winner_loser_validation)
knitr::kable(data.frame(auc_rows = nrow(auc), contrast_rows = nrow(contrasts)))
knitr::kable(validation)
```

### Problems flagged

Non-finite effects, invalid contrast covariance, order mismatches, and legacy-regression failures stop this branch.

### Principal outputs

`auc_inputs`, `auc_contrasts`, and `winner_loser_validation`.

### PASS/FAIL

Maximum-duration raw relative-cover AUC is the response authority for later modeling stages.
## Winner/loser and temporal analysis


### Purpose

Summarize winner/loser and temporal results before resident-model exclusions.

### Inputs

Upstream AUC contrasts and significance-based winner/loser categories across time horizons.

### Decisions and exclusions

All response-stage taxa are retained, including the six taxa excluded only from resident modeling.

### Before/after counts and validation checks

```{r}
winner_loser <- targets::tar_read(winner_loser)
summary <- targets::tar_read(temporal_summary)
kappa <- targets::tar_read(temporal_kappa)
flow <- targets::tar_read(flow_validation)
knitr::kable(data.frame(winner_loser_rows = nrow(winner_loser)))
knitr::kable(summary$counts)
knitr::kable(kappa)
knitr::kable(flow)
```

### Problems flagged

Category-loss, inconsistent linked rows, or failed temporal flow checks stop rendering.

### Principal outputs

`winner_loser`, `temporal_summary`, `temporal_kappa`, and temporal flow/transition targets.

### PASS/FAIL

Temporal conservation and category validations must pass before rendering.
